notes.title: Changes to the leveling system and item drop system.
notes.notes:
-Now points are used to increase the level; each rarity of items is assigned its own number of points.

*Regular – 1 point

*Rare – 4 points

*Epic – 50 points

*Legendary – 100 points

*Items from the in-game store – 15 points


-Added a tab for exchanging items for points.

Item drops remain unchanged, items drop out the same way, once every 3 hours and once every 18 hours.

*Epic items may drop instead of regular items, and Legendary items may drop instead of rare items.

-Chances for epic and legendary items have been reworked:

1lvl - Epic 1/5,000,000; Legendary 1/25,000,000

2lvl - Epic 1/4 000 000; Legendary 1/18,000,000

3lvl - Epic 1/2 500 000; Legendary 1/10,000,000

4lvl - Epic 1/900,000; Legendary 1/5,000,000

5lvl - Epic 1/500,000; Legendary 1/2 800 000

6lvl - Epic 1/250,000; Legendary 1/1,000,000

7lvl - Epic 1/100,000; Legendary 1/500,000

8lvl - Epic 1/50,000; Legendary 1/220,000

9lvl - Epic 1/25,000; Legendary 1/150,000

10lvl - Epic 1/10,000; Legendary 1/100,000

notes.title: Global update
notes.notes:
Changes to the item drop system:

-Now items drop only once every 3 hours and once every 18 hours on any game level.

From levels 1 to 5 drops:

Regular items drop once every 3 hours, with some chance an epic item may drop. An epic item may drop instead of a regular item.

The chance of getting an epic item is 1/5,000,000.

A rare item drops once every 18 hours, and a legendary item has a certain chance to drop. A legendary item may drop instead of a rare one.

Chance of receiving a legendary item is 1*25,000,000

From 5 to 10 level

The chances of getting an epic item are 1/2,500,000

The chance of receiving a legendary item is 1/15,000,000.

AND THE MOST INTERESTING:

AT LEVEL 10, 1 UNIQUE ITEM IS ADDED, WITH A DROP CHANCE OF 1/1,000,000,000. IF YOU DROP THIS ITEM, THE CRAZY CORN TEAM WILL PAY YOU FOR THIS ITEM.

The item can only drop at level 10!

Read all the information about the item and the amount of the reward on our discord server.

-Added game achievements

-Added public workshop.


With love, Crazy Corn developers!
